title: General Provisions
previewText: Subject to the general findings required by Section 73-03 and in accordance with the provisions contained in Sections 73-42 to 73-53, the Board of Standards and Appeals shall have the power to permit modification of use or parking regulations of this Resolution, and shall have the power to impose appropriate conditions and safeguards thereon.
